Input cost is uncached input at the prompt rate; cache read cost uses the input-cache-read rate; output cost uses the completion rate and includes reasoning tokens. Cache-write tokens were zero in every session. The Codex row labelled Luna 5.6 Max records gpt-5.6-sol in its transcript and is therefore priced at the Sol rate. No individual request crossed OpenRouter's 272k-token long-context pricing threshold.
